grammar.title: Never with 从来不/没
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 从来 + 不/没 + 动词
grammar.explanation: 从来 (cónglái) means "ever, always" and is nearly always paired with 不 or 没 to mean "never". It emphasizes that something has (or hasn't) been true the entire time, without exception.

grammar.title: Rhetorical questions with 难道...吗
grammar.pattern: 难道 + 主语 + 动词短语 + 吗？
grammar.explanation: 难道 (nándào) turns a statement into a rhetorical question that expects the opposite answer — like saying "Don't tell me...?" or "Surely not...?" in English. It often pairs with 吗 at the end, and shows the speaker's surprise or disbelief.

sentences.zh: 这个错误造成了很大的影响。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège cuòwù zàochéng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
sentences.en: This mistake caused a big impact.
